items.title: UI/UX Design
items.description: Interfaces built for real use: clear flows, visual hierarchy and interactions that guide the user without friction.

items.title: Product Design & Research
items.description: Interviews, benchmarking and strategy definition to understand what moves the business before any visual decision.

items.title: Design Systems
items.description: Consistent design systems, with reusable components and tokens that scale alongside the product.

items.title: Front-end (HTML/CSS/JS)
items.description: I come from a development background, I deliver specs and components built to reduce handoff friction, and sometimes I build the interface myself.

items.question: How does your process work?
items.answer: I start by understanding the business and user problem, move into research and wireframes, iterate based on feedback, and only then design the final screens, always documenting decisions, not just the outcome.

items.question: Do you work with development teams?
items.answer: Yes, and I speak their language. Coming from front-end, I deliver specs and prototypes designed with technical feasibility in mind, not just aesthetics.

items.question: Are you available for new opportunities?
items.answer: Yes, for positions in UI/UX and Product Design, remote or hybrid, see the details on the Contact page.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: UI/UX designer with roots in development, I think about the experience end to end: from research to interface, and from interface to code when the project calls for it.
about.approachIntro: The best results come from well informed decisions. I understand the business context before designing a single screen, and I never ship an interface without validating that it actually solves the problem.

approachPoints.title: Immersion and research
approachPoints.text: Interviews, benchmarking and flow mapping to understand what the user needs and what moves the business before any visual decision.

approachPoints.title: Information architecture and wireframes
approachPoints.text: I organize content, copy and navigation structure, and test the flow in wireframes before any final interface decision.

approachPoints.title: UI design and design systems
approachPoints.text: Final interfaces consistent with a design system, always validated with the people who will use it.

approachPoints.title: Development and delivery
approachPoints.text: When the project includes development, I build it myself in HTML/CSS/JS. Otherwise, I run a complete technical handoff to the dev team.
